failed_allocs.note: heap allocations that failed since boot (diag.c callback); several callers drop a failure silently

internal_free_kb.note: one reading; 25-55 KB until v1.12.0, ~96 KB in rc.2, ~84 KB since rc.3 (larger task stacks)

internal_min_kb.note: lowest internal RAM since boot, read in perf. 8-10 KB until v1.12.0 (3 KB once); 50 KB with the radar palettes and cJSON in PSRAM (rc.2), 36-40 KB since the task stacks grew ~12.7 KB in rc.3 (main, HTTPS, HTTP, ota, event task, console)

internal_min_kb.place_switch.note: internal RAM's low point over perf's place drags there and back until the radar is done (console memlow: each internal heap's own low point, added up; the real moment was ~15 KB higher). 31 KB on v1.14.2-rc.1 (23-28 with a 6 s wait at each place): the radar read its cached map from flash through a 16 KB internal buffer while alerts and air quality loaded; 39-47 KB with 4 KB reads and air quality's buffer in PSRAM (October 5-6; it varies run to run)

internal_min_kb.reconnect.note: lowest since boot after wifi_setup's reconnect path (three TLS clients + the forecast parse): 4-5 KB until v1.12.0, 76 KB in rc.2, 38-43 KB since rc.3's larger task stacks

lvgl_internal_fallbacks.note: LVGL blocks put in internal RAM because PSRAM was full (lvgl_mem.c)

page_fps.web_place_0.note: a place chosen on the settings page, drawn by slide_page (LVGL scrolled the pager at ~10 fps until rc.6); ref to be set from the first runs

page_fps.web_place_1.note: a place chosen on the settings page, drawn by slide_page (LVGL scrolled the pager at ~10 fps until rc.6); ref to be set from the first runs

page_kb.note: settings page size (sent in 1 KB TLS records); a big jump is worth a look

page_start_ms.web_place_0.note: pictures rendered before the first frame (0 if both ready, ~130 ms each when not)

page_start_ms.web_place_1.note: pictures rendered before the first frame (0 if both ready, ~130 ms each when not)

psram_min_kb.note: v1.11.0: 452-517 KB with the 5-picture cache of slide.c (1042 in v1.10.0); the radar needs ~50 KB to decode plus 217 KB per new frame. With an alert held (v1.14.2): 318-325 KB, at navigation's radar snapshot (434 KB on top of the radar loading its first frames and the 117 KB map)

psram_min_kb.alert.note: PSRAM's low point while an alert arrives on the first place, its region map is drawn, the weather and alert screens are snapshot and places dragged (perf.alert_active, console memlow). 11-190 KB with v1.14.1 (alerts_map took ~830 KB at once, again at every return to the place)

radar_history_s.note: the 14 past radar frames after opening the radar (radar.c pipe_load). 8.3 s one after the other on a quiet day (590 ms a frame: radar download 164 + decode 142, lightning download 95 + decode 135 ms, October 6); 7.4 s skipping empty lightning images alone; 4.5-5.6 s with downloads and decoding overlapped (v1.14.3). Rain makes the images larger (tens of KB): measure on a rainy day before tightening

radar_zoom_start_ms.note: overlays drawn with alpha before the first frame: 52-79 ms since v1.12.1 (only the box the objects cover is cleared, drawn and scanned; ~110 ms before, when whole strips were; drawing alone ~36 ms, the ring 19). "dio": estimated (+30 %), not measured

render_ms.blank.note: a few ms: noise is a large part of it

render_ms.hourly.note: v1.11.1 with QIO flash; "dio": the limits on a DIO board (one updated over the air keeps its DIO bootloader), measured v1.11.1

render_ms.radar.note: v1.11.1 with QIO flash; "dio": the limits on a DIO board (one updated over the air keeps its DIO bootloader), measured v1.11.1

render_ms.weather.note: v1.11.1+ with QIO flash. Depends on the weather shown: the big moon icon ~45 ms (night), the sun ~57 ms (day, measured October 3 at noon on fix.8/fix.9; the daytime cost was there before, the QIO references were all taken at night). "dio": the limits on a DIO board, measured v1.11.1 (moon icon; the sun costs ~12 ms more)

render_ms.weather_with_panel.note: v1.11.1 with QIO flash; "dio": the limits on a DIO board (one updated over the air keeps its DIO bootloader), measured v1.11.1
